text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Power of the Saint, awaken...!! 
Haaaaaaah...!!"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
(Desire-chan, what incredible drive...! 
...Ngh, I'm getting dragged into her 
pace...!)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...Still! I'm definitely not losing this! 
Hyaaaaaaaaaaaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh! Buena Vistaaaa!!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
She's overcome Red Desire's fierce 
fighting spirit! This year's Queen of the 
Oaks is Buena Vista! She has magnificently 
lived up to the fans' expectations!!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Buena Vistaaaa, congratulatioooons!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
That was an in...credible showdown...! 
Just as expected... or maybe beyond 
expectations?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, isn't Desire-chan even more amazing 
than before!? In any other year, it 
wouldn't be surprising if she'd won the 
Double Tiara...！"

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Buena-chan is consistently strong too... 
Whoa, the Shuka Sho is gonna be a crazy 
battle!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Btw, at this rate with Buena-chan... 
Couldn't she, like, totally win the Prix 
de l'Arc de Triomphe too?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa~! I can't give up on either! 
—Buena-chan is way too fired up~!!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh, are you saying... Are you saying 
it's still not enough...?!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Or is it because it's the stage where 
Buena-san's... idol emerged victorious? 
...No, that's not it either. Which means 
she too—"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
—She truly harbors the Schwarz within her. 
Just like me... which is why distance is 
no obstacle. Getting that close makes it 
unmistakable...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"In that case, what I must aim for is... 
the Shuka Sho. In my perfected form—this 
time, I will reach it."

text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
...Desire-san's spirit isn't broken in the 
slightest. She's still ready to challenge 
someone that strong—

text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
...We can't just take this lying down. We 
have reasons we can't back down, too!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Oooohh...!)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
(The heat, the excitement... Everyone's 
fighting spirit... I can feel it reaching 
me. ――My heart is surging wildly...!)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ? Did something just—

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
Buena-chaaan! Keep doing your best out 
there!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, thank you so much for the 
tremendous cheers today!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I'm so happy I could live up to everyone's 
expectations! I'll sprint through the 
final leg, the Shuka Sho, with everything 
I've got!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: I'm back, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Thank you for believing in me!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Hey, we're... in really great shape, 
aren't we?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Everyone is placing their hopes on me. All 
their feelings are gathering toward the 
Shuka Sho...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"If I win the Shuka Sho... I have a 
feeling an amazing, breathtaking view 
awaits!"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Yes, without fail...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—At that moment, I felt a slight sense of 
unease about Buena Vista's condition.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Phew... Phew...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...Phew. ...*pant*...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Pursing her lips slightly, she breathes 
shallowly. I've seen it often since we 
were kids... It's a gesture she makes when 
feeling insecure.
choice_data_list: Buena... is there something worrying you?
Buena... is there something worrying you?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Huh? Uneasy...?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Hmm? Nothing in particular...?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I-I really mean it! I'm sorry, I just have 
no idea...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"Could it be... was there something that 
we actually should have been worried 
about?"
choice_data_list: No, that's not it at all, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Buena Vista is genuinely distressed. It 
doesn't seem like she's lying or playing 
dumb. If she truly isn't aware of it—
choice_data_list:
(Do I have no choice but to wait until she 
finds the words...?)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
There's no way Trainer would mistake me 
for someone else... So what am I so 
anxious about?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...Now I'm starting to get worried...
choice_data_list: Sorry, just forget I said that for now!!
Sorry, please forget about that for now!!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
—About what happened earlier... I'll think 
about it carefully once I'm back at the 
dorms.
choice_data_list: No, please get some good rest today.

No, I'd rather you get plenty of rest 
today.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed, it's right after a race, after 
all. I'll take some time to refresh 
myself!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Then... I guess we'll continue our meeting 
tomorrow. Looking forward to working with 
you for the Shuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Fufu. Thank you, Trainer♪

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: *Yaaawn*...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
(Trainer told me that too... It's a bit 
early, but I think I'll head to bed—)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaah...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Buena Vistaaa!!" "Don't give up..." 
"Looking forward to the next one!" 
"Uooooo...!!" "Run!!"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
――Still, I need to keep my mind on the 
race.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"The marking will be even tighter at the 
Shuka Sho. I've got to build up the power 
to break through if I get boxed in!"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! Summer training camp is right 
around the corner! It's the ultimate 
chance to improve our skills... I'm gonna 
tackle it with everything I've got!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"The Shuka Sho is at Kyoto Racecourse, 
right? I need to hammer the track layout 
into my head—"

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ――... Oh my.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"You're still awake? I thought you said 
you were going right to sleep?"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Is it that time already...!? I'm going 
to bed now. Good night...!
